map.宠物常用药剂量计算器 使用指南: Common Pet Drug Dose Calculator User Guide
map.输入宠物体重与所选药物（如驱虫药、抗生素），工具按每公斤体重给药量计算单次用药剂: Enter the pet's weight and the selected drug (such as a dewormer or antibiotic); the tool computes the single dose and dosing frequency from the per-kg dosage, and shows the common dose range for pet-specific drugs. Results are reference only; follow your veterinarian for actual use.
map.按宠物体重与所选药品的安全剂量范围（mg/kg），算出单次与每日给药剂量，避免过: From the pet's weight and the safe dose range of the selected drug (mg/kg), compute the single and daily doses to avoid overdosing.
map.根据给药频次（单次 / 每 8、12、24 小时）折算每日总剂量，匹配药品说明书: Convert to a daily total from the dosing frequency (once / every 8, 12 or 24 hours) to match the package insert.
map.把毫克剂量换算成 50/100/250mg 片剂片数，方便居家分药（仅供参考，遵: Convert the milligram dose into the number of 50/100/250 mg tablets so home splitting is easier (reference only, follow the veterinary prescription).
map.示例：10kg 犬的某药剂量: Example: a dose for a 10 kg dog
map.：设药品对犬剂量范围 5–10 mg/kg：单次剂量 = 10kg × (5~1: If the drug's canine dose range is 5-10 mg/kg: the single dose = 10 kg x (5-10) = 50-100 mg, averaging 75 mg; at once every 12 hours (24/12 = 2 times a day) the daily total is 100-200 mg; with 50 mg tablets that is 75/50 = 1.50 tablets. Follow the drug data sheet for the exact range.
map.单次剂量 = 体重(kg) × 药品剂量范围(mg/kg)；平均剂量取上下限均值: Single dose = body weight (kg) x drug dose range (mg/kg); the average dose is the midpoint of the limits; the daily total = average dose x doses per day (once daily is 1, every N hours is 24/N). Some drugs marked "not recommended" for a species will trigger a contraindication notice.
map.算出来就能直接喂吗？: Can I feed the computed amount directly?
map.不能。本工具仅为剂量参考，实际用药必须凭兽医处方；肝肾病、孕宠、幼老宠的剂量常需: No. This tool is a dose reference only, and actual medication requires a veterinary prescription; doses often need to be reduced for liver or kidney disease, pregnant pets, and young or old pets, and most human medications are toxic to pets, so never apply them on your own.
